description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named AuthController, providing an endpoint '/auth/me' to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user based on JWT.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Spring REST controller handling authentication-related endpoints, notably providing information about the current user.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/auth/me'; returns whether the user is authenticated, their name, and authorities based on the JWT token.
